{{short description|Romanian mathematician}}
'''Viorel P. Barbu''' (born 14 June 1941) is a [[Romania]]n [[mathematician]], specializing in [[partial differential equation]]s, [[control theory]], and [[stochastic differential equation]]s.

==Biography==
He was born in [[Deleni, Vaslui|Deleni]], [[Vaslui County]], Romania.<ref name="cv">{{cite web|url=http://www.math.uaic.ro/~barbu/|title=Pagina personală Acad. Viorel Barbu|work=uaic.ro}}</ref>  He attended the Mihail Kogălniceanu High School in [[Vaslui]] and then the [[Costache Negruzzi National College]] in [[Iași]]. Barbu completed his undergraduate degree at the [[Alexandru Ioan Cuza University]] of Iași in 1964,<ref name="cv"/> and his [[Ph.D.]] at the same university in 1969.<ref name="nodak.edu">{{MathGenealogy|45992}}</ref>  His doctoral advisor was Adolf Haimovici; his dissertation thesis was titled ''Regularity Theory of Pseudodifferential Operators''.<ref name="nodak.edu"/> He became a professor at the University of Iași in 1980.<ref name="cv"/> 

In 1993, he was elected a titular member of the [[Romanian Academy]].<ref>{{in lang|ro}} [http://www.acad.ro/bdar/armembriLit.php?vidT=B Membrii Academiei Române din 1866 până în prezent] at the Romanian Academy site</ref> In 2011 he was awarded the [[Order of the Star of Romania]], Knight rank by [[President of Romania|President]] [[Traian Băsescu]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://legislatie.just.ro/Public/DetaliiDocument/130017|title=Decret nr. 639 din 7 iulie 2011 privind conferirea unor decorații| website=legislatie.just.ro| language=ro|date=July 7, 2011|access-date=May 1, 2021}}</ref>
